name: Kimi ni Okuru Tsubasa
source:
There was a boy in a rural town. The boy had a very sick sister-in-law who spent most of the day in bed. Girl desired to fly more than anything else in life. Boy though what he could do to make her happy and started inventing wings for her. But as time passed he was running out of time. It's either now or never.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
乡下小镇里住着一名少年。他有一位身患重病的义妹，少女一天中的大部分时间都只能卧床休息。她此生最大的愿望，就是能够飞上天空。少年思索着自己能做些什么令她幸福，于是开始为她发明翅膀。然而，随着时间流逝，留给他的机会已经越来越少。现在不做，便再也来不及了。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
